1.text: Great and holy is the LORD, holy among holy ones, from generation to generation.
Splendor goes before him, and behind him is the roar of many waters.
Steadfast love and faithfulness surround his presence; truth, judgment, and righteousness are the foundation of his throne.
He separates light from darkness; he established the dawn by the knowledge of his heart.
Then all his angels saw and sang for joy, because he showed them what they had not known.
He crowns the mountains with produce, good food for every living thing.
Blessed is the one who made the earth by his power and established the world by his wisdom.
By his understanding he stretched out the heavens and brings the wind out from his storehouses.
He made lightning for the rain and raises clouds from the end [...].
